test_title: PYST 2: SSC GD Constable - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 16th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A sum fetched a simple interest of Rs. 3,040 at the rate of 8% p.a in 5 years. what is the sum?
solution:
Given:

SI = Rs. 3,040 

Rate of interest = 8% p.a 

Duration = 5 years

Concept used:

Simple Interest, SI = (P × R × T)/100

Amount = P + SI

Where, P = Principal amount, R = Rate of interest per year,

T = Time in years

Calculation:

Let, the sum = Rs. P.

According to the question,

⇒ (P × 8 × 5)/100 = 3040

⇒ P × 40 = 304000

⇒ P = 304000/40

⇒ P = 7600

∴ The sum is Rs. 7,600.
